scripts.daily: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),zlib=require('zlib'); if(fs.existsSync('prices.db.gz')){fs.writeFileSync('prices.db',zlib.gunzipSync(fs.readFileSync('prices.db.gz')))}" && node optimize_db.js && node scraper.js --mode=daily && node optimize_db.js && node compress_db.js
